Hi Alicia / Sam,

Following up from our renewal conversation — attached is a draft amendment (Novus_Commit_Amendment_v3.pdf) that formalizes the lift from your current 8-GPU reserved pool to a 16-GPU pool at renewal. High level:

- Effective date: Aug 1, 2026 (start of next billing cycle)
- Capacity: reserved pool increased from 8 → 16 identical GPU instances
- Monthly commit: equivalent of 16 GPUs (~11,520 GPU-hours/month)
- Billing: flat monthly commit fee with standard metered overage rates; we include a 30-day pilot credit (first month) in the draft
- Throughput: we propose a throughput SLO tied to the reserved pool (see throughput_sla_table.xlsx) — baseline concurrency guarantee plus burst policy for traffic spikes

Attachments: Novus_Commit_Amendment_v3.pdf (PDF, 90KB), throughput_sla_table.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

Can you confirm the following so we can finalize legal/finance routing?
1) Acceptance of Aug 1 effective date or preference for phased activation
2) Whether procurement needs a PO number up front (if so, share PO contact)
3) Any remaining security/compliance gating items that would delay the roll (e.g., customer-managed keys, audit window)

If useful, happy to set a quick 20-min call tomorrow to walk the amendment.

Thanks —

Alicia — thanks, good questions. Answers inline below and attached an updated SLA table with explicit burst windows (throughput_sla_table.xlsx).

1) Proration: If activation occurs mid-cycle we prorate the monthly commit back to the activation timestamp. In practice that means: partial-month charge = (days active / days in billing month) * monthly commit. For your Aug 9 target activation we would bill Aug 1–8 at the prorated rate and start the full monthly commit on Aug 9. If you prefer a single-billing activation we can shift the effective date; let us know.

2) Burst window: The attached SLA table includes a 30-minute burst allowance per calendar day where you can exceed baseline concurrency by up to 50% without penalty (intended for validation/load tests). We will log and meter burst usage; sustained usage beyond burst will follow overage pricing.

3) Pricing incentives: We can hold the proposed committed pricing if you sign by Jul 29. Additionally, Laura has approved a one-time 30-day pilot credit that effectively offsets the first month post-activation.

Next steps: 
- If these terms look good, reply with confirmation of activation plan (Aug 1 with phased activation on Aug 9, or set Aug 9 as effective date) and confirm PO path.
- I can send a DocuSign-ready amendment once we get verbal confirmation so legal can review a clean copy.

Attachments: throughput_sla_table.xlsx (XLSX, 30KB)
